acceptance: A data file holds qualification values for all 99 queries with a test comparing a sample against the spec text
Value-level answer parsing has unit tests for normal, NULLS_FIRST and NULLS_LAST answer files
The 8 SF=1-empty queries are confirmed to have non-empty answer sets in a test
context: Source: DataFrame query parity proposal v3 (item T17). Two bindings, two gates: this item supports the qualification binding, separate from the gate binding built from dsqgen -LOG. Project owner does NOT accept earlier reviewers' TPC-H claims.
description: Commit the specification's qualification parameter values as a data file with a test against the spec text (_sources/tpc-ds/specification/specification_4.0.0.pdf). Extend benchbox/core/expected_results/loader.py, which parses only row counts for TPC-DS (parse_tpcds_answer_file, ~line 66), to parse answer-set values (_sources/tpc-ds/answer_sets/<n>.ans), including the _NULLS_FIRST and _NULLS_LAST variants, following the TPC-H load_tpch_value_digests pattern (~line 224). The 8 queries empty at SF=1 in the gate (8, 24, 25, 29, 37, 41, 54, 58) have non-empty official answer sets (verified), so they are parameter problems, not legitimately empty.
